title: Lost in the Forest
description: Two children get lost on a walk and find their way home.
instructions: Read the story about Ben and Mia. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🌲 Last Sunday, Ben and his sister Mia went for a walk in the forest with their uncle. It was a warm day, and the birds were singing. They took sandwiches and a bottle of water.
While their uncle was taking photos of a butterfly, the children walked a little further. They found a small river and followed it. After half an hour, they looked round. Their uncle wasn't there.
'We're lost!' said Mia, and she started to cry. Ben put his arm round her. 'Don't cry,' he said. 'Our uncle told us that if we get lost, we should stay calm and stay in one place.'
They sat on a big stone and ate their sandwiches. It was getting darker, and the forest was becoming cold. Ben put his jacket round Mia. They heard a strange noise, but it was only an owl.
'Let's shout together,' said Ben. They shouted, 'Help! We're here!' again and again. Nothing happened for a long time. Then they heard a dog barking, and the barking got louder.
A big brown dog ran out of the trees, and behind it came their uncle with a torch. 'There you are!' he said, and he hugged them tightly. 'You were very clever to stay here.'
Their uncle explained that the dog, which belongs to a farmer, had found them by following their smell. The farmer was walking behind and he gave the children some warm tea from his flask.
On the way home, Mia said, 'I will never walk away from the group again.' Ben smiled. 'Next time, we should take a map,' he said. Their uncle promised to buy them one.
